name: agentic-mcp

tools.name: ask_all
tools.description: Send a prompt to all configured providers simultaneously and collect their responses. Available providers: none configured. Returns a structured result with each provider's response, success status, and timing.

prompt.description: The prompt or question to send to all providers simultaneously

providers.description: Explicit provider selection. Available: none configured. CLI aliases --provider/--providers both map here, and multi-values may be comma-separated or space-separated.

model.description: Single shared model to use on each selected provider. CLI aliases --model/--models both map here. Use --providers for provider selection. If a selected provider rejects the shared model as unavailable or unsupported, ask_all returns that provider error instead of falling back to a different model.

context.description: Optional user-supplied context to prepend before the current prompt

working_directory.description: Working directory path — the agent will have access to files in this directory

system_prompt.description: Custom system prompt prepended to the conversation for each provider

tools.name: provider_metrics
tools.description: See how many times each AI provider was called overall, with response times and success rates

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: See which AI models are available and their status
